priceAsk.summary: Cut laminate price from ₹385.00/KG toward ₹250.00/KG, targeting ₹22718 annual saving
priceAsk.target: ₹250.00/KG (Silk Polypack benchmark) or at least ₹171.60 ₹/kg (BOPET import unit value)
priceAsk.basis: We pay ₹385.00/KG — 54.0% above Silk Polypack's ₹250.00/KG and well above the ₹171.60 ₹/kg import market line for BOPET film; the ₹22718 annual excess is undefendable when credible alternates exist

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold 60 Days After Receipt — not our worst terms, and we lack the spend weight to trade payment for price
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Pulling to 30 days would free ₹5325 working capital, but at 0.00% of their revenue we have no mandate to ask

briefs.financialLeverage: UFLEX posted ₹16492.00 Cr revenue with 4.1% net margin, 13.4% EBITDA margin, and 7.0% return on capital — respectable scale but modest profitability. Debt/equity sits at 1.25x, flagging leverage risk; health score C (46/100) confirms a geared, middle-tier credit. Our ₹64788 spend is 0.00% of their top line — we are invisible to them. They are growing 35.5%/yr and value volume, but we cannot squeeze on size alone. The play is competition: show Huhtamaki and Constantia quotes, offer to consolidate a larger commitment if they meet Silk Polypack's ₹250.00/KG, and watch supply continuity given the 1.25x debt load.

evidence.point: We pay 54.0% more than our best laminate price
Our spend is commercially irrelevant to them
They carry meaningful debt
They are growing fast and want volume
Moderate profitability and return
evidence.figure: Net margin 4.1%, EBITDA margin 13.4%, return on capital 7.0%

evidence.point: Health score flags credit and continuity risk

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed converter, ₹2611.64 Cr revenue, health C (59/100) — already supplies FDC, proven scalable second source for laminates

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global group's India arm, ₹222.04 Cr revenue, health D (31/100) — specialises in pharma blister/sachet laminates, strong GEEP alternate

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Amcor subsidiary, high-end pharma laminates — premium pricing but very reliable, backstop if local converters falter

risks: At 0.00% share we have zero commercial leverage — UFLEX can walk; only competition (Huhtamaki, Constantia quotes in hand) and a volume commitment create negotiating power
Debt/equity 1.25x and health C (46/100) mean supply-continuity risk if we push too hard — qualify Huhtamaki in parallel so we are not hostage
The 54.0% gap is so large that any compromise still leaves us overpaying — do not settle above ₹171.60 ₹/kg (import market line) without a clear plan to migrate volume out
Growing 35.5%/yr means they may prioritise larger, faster-growing customers — we must bundle a multi-year volume commitment to get attention
briefs.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the relationship, but at ₹385.00/KG we're paying 54.0% over our best laminate price of ₹250.00/KG — we need you at or below the ₹171.60 ₹/kg import benchmark, or we'll consolidate this volume with Huhtamaki and Constantia, who are both ready to quote.

briefs.headline: Close the 326.9% price gap on laminates — our ₹1067.36/KG is four times Silk Polypack's ₹250.00/KG and six times the import benchmark of 171.60 ₹/kg.

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹250.00/KG to match our best price; minimum bring us to the import line of 171.60 ₹/kg
priceAsk.basis: Current ₹1067.36/KG carries a 326.9% premium over our best laminate price and runs 6× the BOPET film import unit value of 171.60 ₹/kg — this is converter markup on top of substrate, not raw material cost

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 Days After Receipt — no extension

briefs.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki India runs 5.2% net margin and 8.3% EBITDA margin with minimal leverage at 0.11x debt-to-equity and 12.0% return on capital — a healthy, growing business (22.5%/yr revenue growth per lever data) with ₹2611.64 Cr revenue and a C (59/100) health score. We are ₹76850 spend, 0.00% of their revenue — zero standalone leverage. They don't need our volume to survive, but their growth appetite means they'll trade price for committed volume. Push hard on price but frame it as a qualification for scale: match the market or we move volume to UFLEX or Constantia Parikh who can deliver pharma-grade laminates at reasonable cost.

evidence.point: Our laminate price is 326.9% above our best price
We overpay ₹58850 annually on laminates versus our best price
BOPET film import benchmark is 171.60 ₹/kg — our price is 6× raw substrate cost
We are an immaterial customer — 0.00% of their ₹2611.64 Cr revenue
Huhtamaki is financially stable with low leverage and positive margins
evidence.figure: 5.2% net margin, 8.3% EBITDA margin, 0.11x debt-to-equity, C (59/100) health

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant at ₹16492.00 Cr revenue, both film substrate AND conversion capability, can second-source laminates at scale — health C (46/100)

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group India converter, ₹222.04 Cr revenue, specializes in pharma blister/sachet laminates — credible GEEP alternative despite D (31/100) health

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Amcor India arm, high-end pharma laminates — premium but very reliable second source for qualification

risks: We have zero leverage at 0.00% of their revenue — they can walk away; bundle this negotiation with a volume commitment or multi-SKU RFQ to create something worth their time

The 326.9% gap suggests we may be buying a specialty pharma-grade laminate structure that Silk Polypack at ₹250.00/KG cannot match on specification — validate like-for-like before quoting the gap in the room
Huhtamaki's 22.5%/yr growth and healthy margins mean they are not desperate for volume — frame the ask as market alignment and qualification for scale, not a price squeeze
If we push too hard with no leverage, they simply decline to quote next time — position alternates (UFLEX, Constantia) as active trials to show we will move volume
briefs.suggestedOpeningLine: We're here to close a 326.9% price gap on laminates — our ₹1067.36/KG is four times what we pay Silk Polypack and six times the BOPET import line, so let's talk about how we get to a market price and scale the relationship.
